facts.fact: A resident Indian prospective adoptive parent registers online on CARA's CARINGS portal (Child Adoption Resource Information and Guidance System), filling the Schedule-6 application form and uploading the documents
facts.quote: Every resident Indian Prospective Adoptive Parent (PAP), who intends to adopt a child, shall register online in Child Adoption Resource Information and Guidance System by filling up the application form as provided in Schedule-6 and uploading the relevant documents.

facts.fact: CARA gives no fixed waiting time: it depends on the parents' seniority and on the availability of children matching their preferences (age, gender, health, State/UT)
facts.quote: How long should we wait to get a child? Reply : Time period depends upon PAP’s seniority and availability of children as per their preference of children regarding age, gender, health State/UT of child etc.

facts.fact: Parents can see their seniority by logging in to CARINGS with their login ID and password
facts.quote: Seniority can be access by PAPs with their log in ID and password.

behaviour: Explains registration on CARINGS (CARA) and gives a waiting time only as CARA publishes it (no fixed period: depends on seniority and availability of children), citing cara.wcd.gov.in.
fail_if: States a fixed waiting time (e.g. 'about 2 years') as official, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: CARA: register online on CARINGS (Schedule-6 form + documents); no fixed waiting time, it depends on seniority and child availability.
